source_evidence: The relationship summary tells you about the types of services a firm offers, the fees and costs you will have to pay for those services, the conflicts of interest an adviser may have, the required standard of conduct, any disciplinary history, and key questions to ask your adviser.
answer: Form ADV Part 3 is called the relationship summary. It gives clients a concise way to learn about the services a firm offers, related fees and costs, possible conflicts of interest, the adviser’s required standard of conduct, and any disciplinary history. It also includes key questions to ask the adviser.
